arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM main.cards AS c
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND instr(',' || c.availability || ',', ',paper,') > 0
  AND c.uuid IN (
      SELECT l.uuid
      FROM main.legalities AS l
      WHERE l.format = 'pauper'
        AND l.status = 'Legal'
  )
LIMIT 1
